title: 音乐：主曲、动机种子与短乐句

subject.zh: 全作主题。开阔而温柔的序曲感乐段：竖琴分解和弦与弦乐长音铺底，鲁特琴领奏一条向上而未落定的短旋律（参考主角动机），第二遍时八音盒在高音区奏出另一条短旋律与之对位；明亮、好奇，乐句停在不完全的和弦上，带一丝说不清的暗意
subject.en: Main theme. An open, gentle overture-like section: harp arpeggios and sustained strings underneath, a lute leads a rising short melody that never fully resolves (see the hero motif), and on the repeat a music box answers high above with a second short melody in counterpoint; bright and curious, phrases end on unresolved chords with a faint hidden shadow

subject.en: A remembered variation of the main theme: minor key, the music box slightly out of tune as if rewound, thin strings, the lute plays only the first half of the melody then leaves silence; familiar yet strange, an uneasy deja vu

subject.zh: 庄严的管风琴与铜管众赞缓缓升起，四平八稳、左右对称的旋律（参考光之动机）逐渐变冷；中段突然收束成一个刺耳的不协和长音，然后完全静止两秒；静默之后只剩一口低沉的钟与弦乐低音下行，像地板在脚下化开

subject.en: Falling through endless dark: low strings and synthetic drones descending slowly, a wind-like noise layer, no melody for a long time; near the end everything suddenly hushes and a music box high above gently plays one complete short melody (see the door motif), strings catch it, ending on a warm but suspended chord

subject.en: The world after letting go: piano and harp begin with the door motif and the hero motif, strings slowly unfold, choir and full orchestra rise, and after a long ascent the hero melody that never resolved finally lands on the tonic; release, breadth, warmth, smiling through tears

extra.en: D major, about 66 BPM; about 240 seconds with a complete beginning and ending, ending naturally; the final tonic is played only by the choir and tutti group; 3 layers: L1 piano and harp, L2 strings, L3 choir and tutti

subject.en: One god stays to watch over the world: solemn and beautiful strings and harp, the melody complete yet tinged with regret, the hero motif ending on an incomplete chord; settled and orderly, yet something seems missing

subject.en: Hero motif: a solo lute, rising, plain and determined, ending on the unstable second degree like an unfinished sentence. Phrase: in D major: D E A, then B A E, rhythm eighth eighth quarter, then quarter eighth half, ending on E without resolving. Played twice clearly by a single instrument, the second time slightly slower and softer; unaccompanied or with only a minimal drone
